stem:
(a) Ethanal, $\text{CH}_3\text{CHO}$, dimerises in alkaline solution according to the following equation.

$$2\text{CH}_3\text{CHO} \rightarrow \text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)CH}_2\text{CHO}$$

The initial rate of this reaction was measured, starting with different concentrations of $\text{CH}_3\text{CHO}$ and $\text{OH}^-$. The following results were obtained.

| $[\text{CH}_3\text{CHO}]/\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ | $[\text{OH}^-]/\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ | initial rate of reaction (relative values) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 0.10 | 0.015 | 1 |
| 0.20 | 0.015 | 2 |
| 0.40 | 0.030 | 8 |

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Deduce the order of the reaction with respect to $\text{CH}_3\text{CHO}$.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Deduce the order of the reaction with respect to $\text{OH}^-$.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: State the overall rate equation for this reaction.

parts.label: (a)(iv)
parts.text: State the units for the rate constant, $k$.

parts.label: (a)(v)
parts.text: Calculate the initial rate of reaction (relative value) for a reaction where the $[\text{CH}_3\text{CHO}]$ is $0.30\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ and $[\text{OH}^-]$ is $0.030\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
(b)(ii)
parts.text: Describe the chemical behaviour of $\text{CH}_3\text{CHO}$ in step 1.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Name the mechanism occurring in steps 2 and 3.
